description: This file contains unit tests for the BonjourEscapes decoding functionality in the ai.openclaw.app.gateway package. It tests the decoding of escape sequences in strings.

classes.name: BonjourEscapesTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the correctness of the BonjourEscapes decoding methods.

methods.name: decodeNoop
methods.description: Tests that decoding an empty string or a string without escapes returns the same string.

methods.name: decodeDecodesDecimalEscapes
methods.description: Tests that escape sequences representing decimal values and Unicode code points are correctly decoded.
